description: This file contains JNI native method implementations for interacting with a binary dictionary used in an Android keyboard application. It includes functions for opening, closing, querying suggestions, validating words, and retrieving all words from the dictionary, as well as JNI registration and setup code.

methods.name: throwException
methods.description: Helper function to throw a Java exception from native code.

methods.name: nativeime_ResourceBinaryDictionary_open
methods.description: Opens a binary dictionary from a direct buffer with specified multipliers.

methods.name: nativeime_ResourceBinaryDictionary_getSuggestions
methods.description: Retrieves suggestions from the dictionary based on input codes.

methods.name: nativeime_ResourceBinaryDictionary_isValidWord
methods.description: Checks if a given word is valid in the dictionary.

methods.name: nativeime_ResourceBinaryDictionary_getWords
methods.description: Retrieves all words from the dictionary and passes them to a callback.

methods.name: nativeime_ResourceBinaryDictionary_close
methods.description: Closes and deletes the dictionary object.
